scope.zh: 聚焦影响AI芯片、存储、设备与材料的出口管制、关税、产业政策与反垄断事件；不含AI模型监管（如欧盟AI法案）。条目按日期排列，每条标注证据级别与未核实之处。 本轮2026-11-12仅对选定条目补证或更新；其余内容保留历史日期，完整覆盖尚未完成。
scope.en: Covers export controls, tariffs, industrial policy and antitrust events that bear on AI chips, memory, equipment and materials. AI-model regulation (e.g. the EU AI Act) is out of scope. Entries are dated and carry an evidence level and what was not verified. The 12 November 2026 review updates selected entries only; other content retains historical dates and complete coverage remains pending.

Global Trade Alert: China's critical-raw-material export controls

summary.zh: 美国政府要求向中国（含香港、澳门）及 D:5 国家出口 H20 需许可，且“在可预见的将来”持续；NVIDIA 预计一季度最多约55亿美元相关费用。2025年8月起部分获准向特定中国客户出货（据其后续 8-K）。
summary.en: The US government required a licence for H20 exports to China (incl. Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries “for the indefinite future”; NVIDIA expected up to about $5.5B of charges in the quarter. Some licences for certain China customers followed from Aug 2025 (per later 8-Ks).

CNBC: NVIDIA $5.5B charge

title.zh: BIS 撤销“AI 扩散规则”并发布指引

summary.zh: 撤销2025年1月15日发布、原定5月15日生效的AI扩散规则；承诺将来发布替代规则，并就华为昇腾芯片、AI模型训练最终用途与供应链转运风险发布三份指引。

title.zh: 中国商务部公告第55–58、61、62号：稀土技术、域外规则与电池材料
title.en: China MOFCOM Announcements 55–58, 61 and 62: rare-earth technology, extraterritorial rule and battery materials

summary.zh: 2025年10月9日发布的一组公告扩大稀土及相关技术、电池材料的出口管制；第61号对含有按价值至少0.1%中国原产受控稀土的外国制品施加管辖。这些公告随后被暂停（见P15、P16），但法律框架仍在。
summary.en: A package issued on 9 Oct 2025 widened export controls on rare earths and related technologies and on battery materials; Announcement 61 would apply Chinese jurisdiction to foreign-made items containing at least 0.1% by value of Chinese-origin controlled rare earths. The package was then suspended (see P15, P16) but the legal framework remains.

sources.label: Pillsbury: China suspends export controls (critical minerals)
Thomson Reuters: China expands export controls on rare earths, battery materials

title.zh: 中国暂停10月措施至2026年11月10日，对美镓锗锑禁令暂停至11月27日
title.en: China suspends the October measures to 10 Nov 2026 and the US gallium/germanium/antimony ban to 27 Nov 2026

summary.zh: 六项10月9日公告（第55、56、57、58、61、62号）自2025年11月7日暂停至2026年11月10日；2024年第46号公告第2条（对美镓、锗、锑及超硬材料等限制）自2025年11月9日暂停至2026年11月27日。2025年4月的七种稀土许可（第18号）与第46号第1条（对美军事用户禁令）仍然有效。
summary.en: The six 9 Oct announcements (Nos. 55, 56, 57, 58, 61, 62) were suspended from 7 Nov 2025 to 10 Nov 2026; Article 2 of Announcement 46 of 2024 (restrictions on gallium, germanium, antimony and superhard materials to the US) was suspended from 9 Nov 2025 to 27 Nov 2026. The April 2025 licensing of seven rare earths (Announcement 18) and Article 1 of No. 46 (ban for US military end users) remain in force.

sources.label: Pillsbury: China suspends export controls (critical minerals)
sources.locator: Suspended announcements; what remains in force; law-firm caveats
sources.reading_scope: Law-firm page text read; MOFCOM originals not opened

caveat.zh: 律所称这是“有条件的暂停，而非完全撤回”，且后续峰会公告未提及通用许可。镓锗锑的暂停将于2026年11月27日到期，之后状态本页尚未核查。
caveat.en: The law firm calls it a conditional pause, not a full rollback, and notes the post-summit announcements make no mention of general licences. The gallium/germanium/antimony suspension ends on 27 Nov 2026; its status afterwards has not been checked here.

date_note.zh: 1月14日签署，1月15日起对窄类先进计算芯片征收。
date_note.en: Signed 14 Jan; the duty applies from 15 Jan 2026 to a narrow category of advanced chips.

title.zh: 第232条款：对特定先进计算芯片征收25%关税
title.en: Section 232: 25% tariff on a narrow set of advanced chips

summary.zh: 总统公告11002对特定先进计算芯片及衍生品征收25%关税；美国数据中心、研发、初创企业等用途获豁免；第二阶段（更广关税与抵扣机制）视谈判而定。
summary.en: Proclamation 11002 imposes a 25% duty on certain advanced computing chips and derivatives; US data-centre, R&D and startup uses are exempt; a broader phase two with an offset programme depends on negotiations.

sources.label: CBP CSMS guidance on Section 232 semiconductor duties
EY: Section 232 proclamation summary

caveat.zh: 截至11月13日的检索未找到第二阶段公告、联邦公报通知或商务部声明；10月的分析文章把今秋出台第二阶段视为基准情形，那是分析师判断，不是官方行动。据二手摘要，1月公告要求商务部在7月1日前就美国数据中心芯片市场提交更新报告，本页未核对。
caveat.en: Searches as of 13 Nov found no Phase 2 proclamation, Federal Register notice or Commerce statement; an October analyst piece treats a fall Phase 2 as the base case, which is a view, not an official action. A secondary summary says the January proclamation required a Commerce update on the US data-centre chip market by 1 July; that was not checked here.

title.zh: BIS：H200 / MI325X 对华许可改为个案审查
title.en: BIS: H200 / MI325X licences to China move to case-by-case review

summary.zh: 《先进计算商品许可审查政策修订》将总处理性能低于21,000且DRAM带宽低于6,500 GB/s的芯片（如 H200、MI325X）由“推定拒绝”改为个案审查；仅限美国直接出口，转口与境外转让仍推定拒绝；并非通用许可。
summary.en: “Revision to License Review Policy for Advanced Computing Commodities” moves chips below 21,000 total processing performance and 6,500 GB/s DRAM bandwidth (e.g. H200, MI325X) from presumption of denial to case-by-case review; direct US exports only, reexports and in-country transfers stay presumption of denial; not a general licence.

sources.label: Federal Register 2026-00789 (91 FR 1684)
Baker McKenzie summary

caveat.zh: 阈值与条件取自律所摘要与公报检索结果，未逐条核对规则全文；数量上限、买家名单等来自博客，未采纳。

title.zh: NVIDIA 10-K：首个H200对华许可已授予，但迄今无H200许可项目收入
title.en: NVIDIA 10-K: first H200 China licence granted, but no revenue from the H200 licensing programme to date

summary.zh: 10-K称2026年2月美国政府授予许可，允许向特定中国客户出货少量H200；须在美国经过检验，并在进口美国时适用25%关税；“迄今未从H200许可项目获得任何收入”。10-K还称中国政府曾鼓励客户购买本土竞争对手产品、劝阻购买或使用其数据中心产品。
summary.en: The 10-K says that in February 2026 the US government granted a licence allowing small amounts of H200 products to be shipped to specific China-based customers; the units must pass inspection in the US, a 25% tariff applies on import into the US, and “to date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program”. It also says the Chinese government has encouraged customers to buy from local competitors and discouraged purchasing, importing or using its data-centre products.

sources.label: NVIDIA Form 10-K for fiscal 2026
sources.reading_scope: First ~100,000 of ~280,000 characters read; risk factors not read

caveat.zh: 只读了10-K前约十万字符（约占36%），风险因素等未读；此条说明许可已授予而非出货量。第三方报道的批量上限等数字未采纳。
caveat.en: Only the first ~100,000 of ~280,000 characters of the 10-K were read and risk factors were not; this records that a licence was granted, not shipment volumes. Volume caps and similar figures from third-party reports are not adopted.

note.zh: 与P12（1月个案审查规则）相互对应。

title.zh: BIS：关联实体规则暂停延至2027年1月10日

summary.en: Effective 9 November, the final rule extends the stay of the specified EAR amendments expanding affiliate end-user controls. This is not a removal of other export-licensing requirements.

sources.label: BIS final rule, 91 FR 70789–70790, 9 Nov 2026
sources.reading_scope: Selected relevant body sections; not full underlying specification or contract

title.zh: 中国将10月稀土等措施的暂停延至2027年1月10日（据报道）
title.en: China reportedly extends the suspension of the October 2025 measures to 10 Jan 2027

summary.zh: 据上海有色网（SMM）11月9日转述，商务部与海关总署2026年第58号公告将第55、56、57、58、61、62号（2025年）公告的暂停从11月11日延至2027年1月10日。同日（11月9日）BIS延长关联实体规则暂停至同一日期（见P13）。
summary.en: SMM reported on 9 Nov that MOFCOM and the General Administration of Customs, in Announcement No. 58 of 2026, extend the suspension of the 2025 Announcements 55, 56, 57, 58, 61 and 62 from 11 Nov to 10 Jan 2027. On the same day BIS extended its Affiliates Rule suspension to the same date (see P13).

sources.label: SMM: China extends suspension of rare earth export controls until January 2027
sources.locator: Announcement text as reproduced by SMM
sources.reading_scope: Page read; no link to the MOFCOM or GACC original

sources.label: MLQ: China extends its pause to 10 Jan
TechTimes (earlier report: no extension yet published)

caveat.zh: 公告编号与新日期只来自二手转述，未读商务部/海关总署原文，条件仅写“经批准”；一篇更早的报道称届时尚未公布延期，应是早于公告发布。两国暂停日期相同，但来源并未说明二者相互关联。
caveat.en: The announcement number and new date come only from secondary reports; the MOFCOM/GACC text was not read and the only condition stated is “upon approval”. An earlier article said no extension had been published, which appears to predate the announcement. The two countries’ suspensions share a date, but the sources do not say they are linked.

note.en: Next check dates: 27 Nov 2026 (gallium/germanium/antimony suspension ends) and 10 Jan 2027.
